description: Add a video to the end of a video surface, from an https URL to an mp4, webm, mov or m4v file. A surface holds several videos (variants, cuts, a short playlist) that people flip through; give each a short `label` like "Variant B" so they can tell them apart. Create the tab first with `create_surface` and `kind: "video"`. Pass `content_type` when the URL has no file extension. Editor role required. Emits `video.updated`.

content_type.description: Optional: video/mp4, video/webm, video/quicktime or video/x-m4v. Inferred from the URL's extension when omitted.

label.description: Optional short label shown in the switcher, e.g. "Variant B". Max 60 chars.

name.description: Optional file or clip name. Max 200 chars.

slug.description: The workspace slug. Accepts bare or org-prefixed form.

surface_slug.description: Optional video surface slug. Omit for the first video surface.

url.description: https URL of the video file.

name: add_video
